name: Semimaru Kururi
source:
Role: Self-styled Super Detective

Just like her kouhai [url=/c1435]Akihito[/url], Kururi is also a habitual class skipper. They often meet at the school's rooftop. She wanders is the city streets every night trying to solve the mysterious events taking place in there. She calls herself a "Super Detective" and always emphasizes that the "super" part is super important.
